title: Autumn Internationals rugby — The Lenches Club
body: The Lenches Club is showing the Autumn Internationals live on Friday 6, Saturday 7 and Sunday 8 November. On Friday it's Ireland v Argentina (kick-off 8.10pm). Saturday has Italy v South Africa (11.40am), Scotland v New Zealand (2.10pm) and Wales v Japan (4.40pm), and on Sunday it's England v Australia (3.10pm). Come for the rugby and a few drinks, and on Saturday stay on for the club's Fireworks Night.
